finalText:
All 5 tests pass.

**The bug** — `paginate.js:7`:

```js
const start = page * perPage;      // before
const start = (page - 1) * perPage; // after
```

The doc comment says pages are 1-indexed, but the offset was computed as if they were 0-indexed. Every request was shifted one page forward: `paginate(items, 1, 3)` returned `[4,5,6]` instead of `[1,2,3]`, and page 4 of 4 (the partial last page) came back empty. `pageCount` was already correct and needed no change.

One note on the earlier `node --test tests/` failure: that was my invocation, not the code — Node resolved the bare `tests` directory path oddly on Windows. Running `node --test tests/paginate.test.js` works.
